rejected_facts.reason: The listed source returned HTTP 403 during Codex review, and the claim combines mutable third-party prices with separate Roblox product checks that are not linked in source_url.

The source supports the old Rebirth 1 cost, but the claim mixes that table with a later Update 7 change; the post-update cost sequence is explicitly uncertain and should not be published as an approved fact.
The listed source could not be opened reliably during Codex review, so the code-input behavior was not approved from this fact record.

The single listed source supports the Discord link and its own wiki/Trello statement, but it does not by itself establish the claim about multiple outlets; the absence of a wiki or Trello is also time-sensitive.

notes: Codex independently opened the HTTPS sources through the configured system proxy; Grok's self-reported verification was not treated as approval.
Official identity, canonical Roblox place, universe ID, and developer were cross-checked against Roblox's live game, universe, and group responses.

The minimum beginner-guide gate is exceeded: approved gameplay/progression facts include the buy-egg-cash loop, merging, offline production, Lucky Blocks, tutorial collection/deposit steps, buy and merge pads, and rebirth/reset guidance.
Facts tied to Update 7 or other mutable game state must be presented with their check date and must not be rewritten as evergreen promises.
No current promo-code list, complete chicken tier tree, complete rebirth table, or exact Gem Upgrade effects are approved.
